summary: Where a person stands changes which tower appears above a familiar building.
realLife: New York’s landmarks commissioners observed that nearby towers fell out of sight on a closer approach to Grand Central. A tower directly on the terminal would stay in view.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with street, landmark, tower. A commissioner can give a resident a street approach from which to check the finding.

turns.what: A resident brings a photo from a different corner where both towers would be visible.
turns.pulledBy: The camera position and direction can be located on the street map.
turns.writesBack: The commission adds the second view to its findings.

turns.what: When the commissioners visit the corner, scaffolding hides the roofline in the hearing photograph.
turns.pulledBy: The scaffold went up after the photographer's dated visit.
turns.writesBack: The site visit notes distinguish the temporary obstruction from the proposed tower.
